mapper.insert: INSERT INTO guest_account (id, display_name, status, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{displayName}, #{status}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
INSERT INTO guest_credential (id, account_id, provider, subject, secret_hash, verified_at, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{accountId}, #{provider}, #{subject}, #{secretHash}, #{verifiedAt}, #{at})

INSERT INTO guest_id_verification (account_id, id_number_enc, id_number_hmac, id_number_mask, real_name_enc, real_name_mask, status, submitted_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{idNumberEnc}, #{idNumberHmac}, #{idNumberMask}, #{realNameEnc}, #{realNameMask}, 'PENDING', #{at}, #{at})
mapper.update: UPDATE guest_id_verification SET id_number_enc = #{idNumberEnc}, id_number_hmac = #{idNumberHmac}, id_number_mask = #{idNumberMask}, real_name_enc = #{realNameEnc}, real_name_mask = #{realNameMask}, status = 'PENDING', verified_at = NULL, submitted_at = #{at}, updated_at = #{at} WHERE account_id = #{accountId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO guest_session (id, account_id, token_hash, issued_at, expires_at, version) VALUES (#{id}, #{accountId}, #{tokenHash}, #{issuedAt}, #{expiresAt}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS session_id, s.account_id AS account_id, a.display_name AS display_name, s.expires_at AS expires_at FROM guest_session s JOIN guest_account a ON a.id = s.account_id WHERE s.token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND s.revoked_at IS NULL AND s.expires_at > now() AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE guest_session SET revoked_at = #{at}, revoke_reason = #{reason}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{sessionId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT account_id, id_number_mask, real_name_mask, status, submitted_at FROM guest_id_verification WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY submitted_at, account_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM guest_id_verification WHERE status = 'PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO guest_verification_review (id, account_id, id_number_mask, real_name_mask, decision, source, reason, detail, reviewer_id, reviewer_name, decided_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{accountId}, #{idNumberMask}, #{realNameMask}, #{decision}, #{source}, #{reason}, #{detail}, #{reviewerId}, #{reviewerName}, #{decidedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, account_id, id_number_mask, real_name_mask, decision, source, reason, detail, reviewer_id, reviewer_name, decided_at FROM guest_verification_review WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY decided_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO guest_ownership_challenge (id, account_id, provider, subject, code_hash, expires_at, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{accountId}, #{provider}, #{subject}, #{codeHash}, #{expiresAt}, #{at})
mapper.update: UPDATE guest_ownership_challenge SET attempts = attempts + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND consumed_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT provider, subject, verified_at FROM guest_credential WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY provider, subject
SELECT count(*) FROM guest_credential WHERE account_id = #{accountId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM guest_credential WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND provider = #{provider} AND subject = #{subject}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO guest_login_challenge (id, provider, subject, code_hash, expires_at, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{provider}, #{subject}, #{codeHash}, #{expiresAt}, #{at})
mapper.update: UPDATE guest_login_challenge SET attempts = attempts + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND consumed_at IS NULL
UPDATE guest_login_challenge SET consumed_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND consumed_at IS NULL AND attempts < 5 AND expires_at > now()
mapper.select: SELECT c.account_id FROM guest_credential c JOIN guest_account a ON a.id = c.account_id WHERE c.provider = #{provider} AND c.subject = #{subject} AND a.status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1
SELECT account_id, subject, secret_hash FROM guest_credential WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND provider = 'USERNAME'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO guest_password_reset_challenge (id, provider, subject, code_hash, expires_at, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{provider}, #{subject}, #{codeHash}, #{expiresAt}, #{at})
mapper.update: UPDATE guest_password_reset_challenge SET attempts = attempts + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND consumed_at IS NULL
UPDATE guest_password_reset_challenge SET consumed_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND consumed_at IS NULL AND attempts < 5 AND expires_at > now()
